findings.title: Weak password policy for finance users
findings.description: AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS only enforces a minimum length of 6 characters and has no common-password check.

findings.cweName: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers (clickjacking)
findings.title: Payment approval pages can be framed
findings.description: XFrameOptionsMiddleware was removed from MIDDLEWARE during the dashboard refactor, so payment approval pages can be embedded in frames on other sites.

findings.title: Open redirect in SSO callback next parameter
findings.description: The SSO callback redirects to the next parameter without url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme(). Attackers can craft login links that land users on a look-alike site.

findings.cweName: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort
findings.title: Legacy SHA1 password hasher still enabled
findings.description: PASSWORD_HASHERS still lists SHA1PasswordHasher for users migrated from the old platform, so their hashes are never upgraded to a modern algorithm.
